confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on several travel and cost-of-living sites (dated roughly 2023 to 2026) that broadly agree on bands but conflict in detail and mix resort and local venues. Beer is a domestic bottle at restaurant prices, the nearest basis for draft. wine_glass has no direct restaurant price source and is set at 2x the beer anchor, the local beer-relationship basis. Cocktail is based on several bar price ranges (about $6 to $12). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for assumed July low-season rates, with no accommodation search, listing check or tax/fee breakdown, so they are the least certain. FX is the latest RBA figure found in search results (18 Nov 2026); no 19 Nov figure was located.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dominican Republic resort-coast basis: restaurant and drink anchors reflect Punta Cana tourist-zone price guides cross-checked against Dominican Republic-wide cost-of-living estimates. A Western Union city comparison puts a mid-range dinner for two at about $50 in Punta Cana, Santo Domingo and Cabarete. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for a resort-dominated market with few hostels, not a named comparable city.
